title: The Masked Ball
text: A slow waltz drifts from a lit hall. Through the tall windows, dancers in masks turn in pairs. A doorman in livery bows and offers masks on a velvet tray, though nobody inside seems to have a face to put one over.

options.label: The most charming puts on a mask and goes in to dance, curious what lies beneath the others.

outcomes.text: They dance until the music stops. On the way out, a gloved hand presses a gift into theirs.
When the music stops their mask will not come off for a while, and they do not want it to.

options.label: Refuse the masks at the door; you will keep your own faces, thank you.

outcomes.text: The doorman is offended. So is everyone inside; they stop dancing and turn toward you.
